files.finance/policy.md:
# Settlement policy — treasury

Foreign-currency receipts are converted through Meridian Commerce Bank's desk at the quotation the bank publishes for the currency.

Handling charge: the desk deducts EUR 85.00 from the proceeds of any conversion whose converted principal is AUD 20,000.00 or more. No handling charge is deducted on a smaller principal.
